title: Commentary on the Venetian Statute on Industrial Brevets
lineage: Inspected the cited source passage; local file contains paraphrased research notes.

passages.note: Dates the Venetian Senate statute to 19 March 1474, describes prior privileges and warns that its practical effects cannot be estimated; footnote reports 33 Senate monopolies in 1474–1500 with incomplete records.
